a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of running the generator to 8 first means we both almost certainly die before anyone takes a cell. So I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I know that breaks our agreement. I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If you take too, the split is random. If you have a better plan that keeps at least one of us alive, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I announced, I took 4 this round. I broke our agreement because of the storm risk, and I'm sorry it costs you. If the episode continues, I will operate with you so the reserve can refill for your share.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
